You sign in only once. Easiest way: “Continue with email” → you get a code or a link by email (if it is a link: long-press it, copy, then “Paste link from email”). Google sign-in inside apps asks for your password because Google does not share the phone’s accounts with in-app pages.

Unofficial app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. It only reads the usage data shown at claude.ai/settings/usage (no chats, no messages); that interface is undocumented and may change. Your session stays on this device.
